title: Fall Commencement
seo_title: Fall Commencement at Missouri State University, Dec 11
description: Fall Commencement ceremonies for Missouri State University graduates are held at Great Southern Bank Arena, with the 10 am ceremony covering the Darr College of Agriculture, College of Business, College of Natural and Applied Sciences, and Interdisciplinary Academic Programs, and the 1:30 p.m. ceremony covering the McQueary College of Health and Human Services, Reynolds College of Arts, Social Sciences, and Humanities, and College of Education. No ticket is required and there is no limit on guests per graduate; doors open 90 minutes before each ceremony, only clear bags are permitted, and non-reserved seating is available for guests with disabilities. It takes place Friday, December 11, 2026 in Springfield, MO, with parking in designated lots and no permits needed.
